nodes.guardrail: Before deepening this direction, verify that your defense is sufficient to hold a potential Terran ground push, especially if they have Siege Tanks and Medivacs. If your defense is light or uncertain, prioritize reinforcing your defensive structures and units before continuing to expand your economy and production.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see a shift in Terran composition (e.g., more air units) or when you are ready to take a more aggressive stance.
